question.en: Which area does the BenchCouncil annual table assign to Tree-based models v.s. deep learning?
question.zh: BenchCouncil 年度表把 Tree-based models v.s. deep learning 归入哪个领域？

explanation.en: Tree-based models v.s. deep learning appears in the Evaluation Analysis area of the official annual table.
explanation.zh: Tree-based models v.s. deep learning 位于官方年度表的“评测与分析”领域。
